text:
The most likely answer is the Annie Award for Character Animation in an Animated Television Production, which the series won at the 34th Annie Awards for the episode "The Blind Bandit." Those awards were held in 2007 and honored 2006 work, so "2006" may refer to the work's year rather than the ceremony year. I haven't opened the Annie Awards site to check the episode credit, so treat the specific attribution as unverified ([Wikipedia: Avatar season 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2); [Annie Award for Character Animation, TV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annie_Award_for_Outstanding_Achievement_for_Character_Animation_in_an_Animated_Television/Broadcast_Production)).

CONFIDENCE: 55
